subject.title: fix: serialize outbound deliveries per channel+recipient

question: Should maintainers sponsor a replacement/rework for this proof-positive delivery-ordering bug, or leave the dirty draft waiting for the contributor?
rationale: The bug and proof are strong, but the safe fix shape crosses durable queue ownership, canonical target derivation, and stalled-send recovery in ways that need an owner decision before automation should rewrite the PR.

options.title: Sponsor a replacement rework
options.body: Build the fix around the existing durable lane/claim path with canonical targets and bounded waits, preserving contributor credit and proof context.

options.title: Return to author
options.body: Keep the draft open and ask the contributor to rebase and address the queue-layer findings before another merge review.

options.title: Pause the draft
options.body: Leave the proven bug for a later owner-backed fix if no maintainer wants to carry the non-trivial delivery-queue work now.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a replacement rework
recommendation.body: Build the fix around the existing durable lane/claim path with canonical targets and bounded waits, preserving contributor credit and proof context.

likelyOwner.reason: The safest decision point is the durable outbound queue boundary introduced in their merged crash-recovery work.
